batchImport.title: Batch Import
batchImport.subtitle: Import multiple cards at once from a CSV file or paste directly.
batchImport.howToStep1: 1. Prepare a spreadsheet with columns: word, translation, sentence (optional), association (optional). This will be the structure of your deck. Each row represents a card, E.g.: book | книга | The book is on the table | reading material
batchImport.howToStep2: 2. Save your spreadsheet as a .csv file. Upload the CSV or copy and paste it into the field above. If the decks aren't exporting correctly, try selecting another CSV separator.

projectSelector.createNewProjectDesc: Projects help you organize different learning goals separately.

onboarding.step1Desc:
Your brain remembers things better when you review them at increasing intervals, right before you’re about to forget them.

This app uses this method to figure out the optimal moment to quiz you.
onboarding.step2Desc:
Use projects to organise your learning tracks, e.g., “Chinese”, “Spanish”, and set up a specific schedule for each.

Place 20-30 items into a single deck to smooth the learning curve.
onboarding.step3Desc:
Learn on a desktop or a mobile and track your project progress in the stats dashboard. Practice intensively by flipping the deck or using Weekend mode.

Happy learning!
